assignments.rationale: GLM-130B is the earliest retained primary technical seed for the GLM lineage and is needed to establish the pre-ChatGPT large-model baseline without projecting later GLM properties backward.
The initial Qwen technical report anchors the Qwen lineage and its early family/platform, alignment, tool-use, and planning orientation.

DeepSeek LLM supplies the material early-family baseline required to show the later V2/R1/V4 transitions as evolution rather than an abrupt start; unresolved size/distribution details are not required for this structural role.

The October 2023 Kimi launch lead is secondary-source only and remains insufficient for an unqualified historical claim; the Architecture will preserve this chronology as an explicit limitation rather than select the source.
ChatGLM-6B is a concrete early GLM ecosystem milestone linking consumer local deployment with a historically distinct model-use/commercial-permission regime.
The GLM-4 family report is the canonical bridge from GLM-130B/ChatGLM to the All Tools agent-oriented GLM-4 era.
GLM-4.5 marks the explicit ARC-centered Agentic/Reasoning/Coding strategy and MoE transition in the GLM lineage.
GLM-5.2 is the current in-scope GLM endpoint and supplies source-bounded long-context efficiency, thinking-control, serving, and distribution evidence.
Qwen2.5 is the material bridge from the early Qwen family to a broad platform strategy with specialized Math, Coder, reasoning, and multimodal branches.
Qwen3 is the central hybrid-reasoning and broad open-weight distribution transition, combining dense/MoE breadth with thinking/non-thinking operation.
Qwen3.6-27B provides the current Qwen endpoint for agentic coding, repository-level reasoning, thinking-history behavior, deployment, and Apache-2.0 distribution.
DeepSeek-V2 defines the MLA/DeepSeekMoE efficiency architecture branch that materially changes the DeepSeek lineage and later frontier-serving story.
DeepSeek-R1 is the major reasoning-RL transition and must be retained with native R1/R1-Zero and distilled variants kept separately attributed.
DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 is the current in-scope DeepSeek endpoint for agentic positioning and official serving support; broader V4 architecture remains explicitly bounded rather than inferred.
Kimi k1.5 is the first retained primary technical bridge from Kimi's long-context identity into disclosed multimodal reasoning and scaled-RL research.
Kimi K2 is the major transition from long-context reasoning research to a large open agentic MoE family with disclosed optimization, data synthesis, and RL methods.

Kimi K3 is the current Moonshot endpoint, representing the native-multimodal, 1M-context, KDA/gated-MLA, long-horizon agentic branch; exact legal conditions remain delegated to the separate license artifact.
MiniMax M2.7 is a material competing 2026 agentic frontier branch that tests the four-central-family narrative without being promoted into a fifth co-equal lineage.
Yi-1.5 is useful supporting context for the 2023-2024 open-weight/local-deployment wave and licensing/ecosystem comparison, but not a primary 2026 frontier lineage.

Baichuan-M3-235B is supporting evidence for specialization and derivative ecosystem dynamics, illustrating how an earlier independent brand can become domain-specialized and Qwen-derived rather than remain a co-equal general frontier family.

The exact Kimi K3 License is material primary evidence for the report's Open Source/Open Weight distinction and for artifact-specific commercial and attribution conditions without turning the report into legal advice.
The X runtime-adoption signal lacks primary repository corroboration in the accepted task and cannot support performance, memory, integration-prevalence, or ecosystem-prevalence claims.

The X license-friction discussion cannot establish infringement, derivative provenance, applicable version, or legal interpretation; the exact D021 license is the authoritative material artifact instead.
The X enterprise-origin-policy observation lacks non-X corroboration and cannot establish prevalence, sector scope, geography, or formal procurement policy.

architecture.editorial_thesis: 中国発Frontier AIの台頭は単一の『中国勢』戦略ではなく、GLMの公開・ローカル展開からARC/長文脈servingへ、Qwenのfamily/platform拡張からhybrid reasoningとagentic codingへ、DeepSeekのMLA/MoE効率化からreasoning RLへ、Kimiのlong-context研究からopen agentic MoE・native multimodalへという異なる系譜が、Open Weight distributionとdeveloper ecosystemを介して並行収斂した過程として描く。競争力は横断benchmark順位ではなく、各versionで確認できるarchitecture、post-training、serving、distribution、license境界の変化から説明する。
architecture_goals: DeepSeek、Qwen、GLM、Kimiを独立したmodel-family lineageとして保持し、後知恵で一つの中国モデル戦略へ統合しない。
reasoning、coding、long context、agentic capabilityへの移行を、各familyのversion-specific architecture、training/post-training、servingの変化と接続する。
Open Weight、local deployment、serving stack、developer distributionを技術競争力の構成要素として扱いつつ、artifactごとのlicenseと権利境界を分離する。
MiniMax、Yi、Baichuanを補助線として残し、2026年の競争構造を主要4系統だけで閉じた物語にしない。
secondary-only Kimi chronology、X/community signal、非互換benchmark比較を明示的な限界として保持し、Architectureで事実へ昇格させない。

page_plan.notes: LONGFORM_SPECIALとして、前史・主要4系統・並行競合・Open Weight/license境界を7つのdraft packageに分割する。ページ数は後続synthesisで重複を統合して調整し、familyごとの系譜とcross-cuttingなecosystem論を混線させない。

packages.title: 前史と分岐点：大規模モデルから主要4系統へ
packages.purpose: GLM-130B、初期Qwen、DeepSeek LLMを一次資料ベースの初期座標として置き、後年のarchitectureやreasoning能力を過去へ投影せずに、中国発foundation modelが複数の独立系譜へ分岐した前史を構成する。
must_cover_requirements: 初期modelの性質を後年のsuccessorから逆算せず、各primary sourceが直接支える範囲だけでchronologyを作る。
GLM、Qwen、DeepSeekを最初から別familyとして示し、Kimiの2023年起点はsecondary-only limitationとして後段へ引き継ぐ。
Open/model-distributionの語をversionごとの実際のartifactとrightsへ結び付け、時代横断の単一license概念を置かない。
boundaries: Cross-family benchmark ranking is excluded where model versions, benchmark conditions, or evaluation methods are incompatible.
Kimi's October 2023 launch/context-window chronology remains secondary-source qualified and is not used as an unqualified foundation-date fact.

packages.title: GLM：公開・ローカル展開からARCと長文脈servingへ
packages.purpose: ChatGLM-6Bのconsumer deploymentと権利境界、GLM-4 All Tools、GLM-4.5のARC/MoE、GLM-5.2の長文脈効率・servingを一つのversion-specific lineageとして追う。
must_cover_requirements: ChatGLM-6Bのweight/commercial permissionsとrepository code licensingを混同しない。
GLM-4 All ToolsからGLM-4.5 ARCへのagentic strategyの変化をversion名付きで説明する。
GLM-5.2のIndexShare、1M context、serving path、効率値はmodel-card/vendor claimとして条件付きで扱う。
boundaries: GLM-4.5 ARC framing is family/version-specific and is not generalized into a common Chinese-model training recipe.
Vendor efficiency figures remain source- and condition-bound rather than independent cross-family performance facts.

packages.title: Qwen：family/platform拡張からhybrid reasoningとagentic codingへ
packages.purpose: Qwen2.5の広いfamily/platform構成、Qwen3のthinking/non-thinking統合とApache-2.0 distribution、Qwen3.6のagentic coding/current endpointを連続したstrategyとして整理する。
must_cover_requirements: Qwen2.5のplatform breadthとspecialized branchesをQwen3以降のreasoning戦略への橋として扱う。
Qwen3のdense/MoE familyとthinking-budget controlをversion-specificに説明する。
hosted proprietary variantsとopen-weight artifactsをdistribution/licensing上同一視しない。
boundaries: Qwen benchmark and capability statements remain tied to the named report/model card and are not normalized into a cross-family ranking.
Later Qwen architecture or licensing properties are not projected backward onto the 2023 initial Qwen release.

packages.title: DeepSeek：MLA/MoE効率化からreasoning RLとagentic servingへ
packages.purpose: DeepSeek-V2のMLA/DeepSeekMoEをfamily-defining efficiency transitionとして置き、R1/R1-Zeroのreasoning RL、V4-Flash-0731のagentic/serving endpointへ接続する。
must_cover_requirements: DeepSeek-V2のKV-cache/throughput等の数値比較を論文の評価条件から切り離さない。
R1-Zero、R1、distilled Qwen/Llama variantsを異なるmodel subjectsとして明確に分離する。
V4-Flash-0731で直接確認できるagentic positioningとvLLM/DSpark supportのみをcurrent endpointとして用い、別sourceのV4 architectureを補完しない。
boundaries: Paper-reported efficiency comparisons are setup-bound and are not generalized across unrelated serving stacks.
The broader DeepSeek V4 architecture is not silently imported into the V4-Flash-0731 Evidence boundary.

packages.title: Kimi：long-context RLからopen agentic MoE・native multimodalへ
packages.purpose: secondary-onlyな2023 launch leadを限界として明示したうえで、k1.5のlong-context multimodal RL、K2のopen agentic MoE、K3の1M-context native multimodal/agentic endpointという一次・公式資料で確認できる技術系譜を構成する。
must_cover_requirements: 2023 Kimi launch/context chronologyはsecondary-source qualifiedであることを本文上も維持し、historical priorityを主張しない。
k1.5とDeepSeek-R1のchronologyから単純な模倣・先後関係を推論しない。
K3のlicense意味はmodel cardから推論せず、別packageのD021 exact licenseへ委譲する。
boundaries: Kimi's October 2023 launch/context-window chronology remains secondary-source qualified until a stronger first-party archival source is added.
Kimi k1.5 and DeepSeek-R1 are treated through their disclosed techniques and chronology without unsupported imitation or priority claims.

packages.title: 並行する競争線：MiniMax、Yi、Baichuanが示す別経路
packages.purpose: MiniMax M2.7をmaterial competing frontierとして扱い、Yi-1.5とBaichuan-M3をopen-weight wave、local deployment、specialization/derivative ecosystemのsupporting bridgeとして配置し、主要4系統だけで競争史を閉じない。
must_cover_requirements: MiniMax M2.7のAgent Teams、skills、tool-search等はofficial announcementが直接支える範囲で扱う。
Yi-1.5を2026 frontier endpointとして誤認せず、2023-2024 open-weight/local-deployment bridgeとして限定する。
Baichuan-M3のmedical specializationとQwen3-MoE ancestryを、旧Baichuan独立系譜の完全な連続性を証明するものとして扱わない。
boundaries: MiniMax is a visible competing branch, not a fifth co-equal central family in this thematic architecture.
X runtime-adoption and enterprise-origin-policy observations remain HOLD and cannot support prevalence or performance claims.

packages.title: Open Weightは一枚岩ではない：distribution、local deployment、license境界
packages.purpose: Kimi K3のexact licenseを中心に、Yi/BaichuanのApache-2.0系artifactをsupporting comparisonとして用い、weights公開、code、commercial use、attribution、Model-as-a-Service条件がartifactごとに異なることを整理する。
must_cover_requirements: Open SourceとOpen Weightを同義語として扱わず、weights、code、license、commercial conditionsを別々に記述する。
Kimi K3 Licenseのgrant、Model-as-a-Service条件、attribution/display条件をexact artifactに限定して要約する。
license記述を法的助言、infringement判断、third-party compliance判断へ拡張しない。
boundaries: The Kimi K3 License summary is artifact-specific and is not a legal opinion.
X license-friction discussion remains HOLD and cannot establish infringement, derivative provenance, applicable version, or legal interpretation.
